champion.builds: THE BEST MASTER YI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Master Yi Bot build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Demolish and Overgrowth in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Tenacity and Slow Resist in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Kraken Slayer as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Terminus, Wit's End and finish with Blade of The Ruined King. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 62.6% winrate over 91 matches played. Situational Master Yi Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Master Yi build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Master Yi runes page.
